title: Europe's most capped men
brief: Name the ten players from European (UEFA) nations with the most caps in official full internationals.
period: All full internationals to 19 July 2026. Germany includes West Germany.

notes.Martin Reim: Martin Reim (Estonia) has 157 (156 in FIFA's count), level with Vertonghen for 10th.
notes.Jan Vertonghen: Jan Vertonghen and Martin Reim share 10th on 157.
notes.Granit Xhaka: Granit Xhaka is 12th with 152, just outside.
notes.Vitalijs Astafjevs: Astafjevs has 167 in Latvia's and RSSSF's count (166 in Wikipedia's list, 168 on Transfermarkt).

checks: Ronaldo, Modric, Ramos, Buffon, Casillas, Lewandowski, Vassiljev, Perisic, Vertonghen and Xhaka: Wikipedia's list and Transfermarkt's match list to 19 July 2026 agree. Astafjevs: 167 in his Wikipedia article and RSSSF (list 166, Transfermarkt 168); every count keeps him between 5th and 7th. Reim: 157 in his article, RSSSF and Transfermarkt, 156 in Wikipedia's list, so 10th is a pool of Vertonghen and Reim. Modric, Perisic and Lewandowski played again in September and October 2026; those caps are left out.
